answer: Female sterilisation, also called tubal ligation, is a surgical procedure where a trained doctor blocks or cuts the tubes that carry eggs to the womb, so sperm and egg cannot meet. If you might want children later, long-acting reversible methods like the implant or IUD are better choices.

title: What a vasectomy is
answer: A vasectomy is a simple, safe operation for men. A trained provider closes the small tubes that carry sperm from the testicles, so the semen no longer contains sperm. It is done with local numbing and takes a short time. It is meant to be permanent and is for men who are sure they do not want any more children.
